fusions.name: Sleeve Draw
fusions.desc: Throws a small hatchet that deals 5 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hidden Bite
fusions.desc: A short chop from close in that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Palmed Blade
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Saved for the Next
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 50% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
